messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error in function recordTable
parts:
Dear Avantika, 
can you please share details of your folder structure? I'd need to know how you organized your images to see what the problem is. 

But it seems that you identified species with metadata (you defined argument "metadataSpeciesTag"). In that case, set IDfrom = "metadata".
Also, you don't seem to have camera subdirectories and no camera IDs in the file names. Thus, remove the argument "cameraID". "camerasIndependent" would also be obsolete then. 

If that doesn't help, please provide more details about how you organised and identified your images.
Best regards,
Jürgen

messages.subject: Re: Error in function recordTable
parts: Thank you Juergen. I found out that i had not configured digikam the way it was supposed to (settings -> configure digikam -> metadata -> write this info. to the metadata -> tick image tags ; sidcar -> untick Read from sidcar files and write to sidecar files). Now i am getting correct record tables with the following command-

camerasIndependent = TRUE,
exclude = "Blank",
minDeltaTime = 15,
deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastRecord",
metadataSpeciesTag = "Species",
timeZone = "Asia/Kolkata",
writecsv = TRUE,
outDir = "C:/Users/Lalit/Desktop/Uttarkashi digikam test 1")
